cases.title: Admin user can sign in with correct credentials
steps: Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email
expected_results: Response HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard
Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session
Dashboard element user-role contains text admin

cases.title: Login trims whitespace and lower‑cases email address
steps: Enter email with leading/trailing spaces and uppercase into login-email
expected_results: Response HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard
Dashboard element user-role contains text admin

cases.title: Sign‑in fails with incorrect password
expected_results: Response HTTP 401
Element login-error contains text "Invalid email or password."

cases.title: After a failed attempt, correct credentials still allow sign‑in
steps: Observe login-error with text "Invalid email or password."
expected_results: Second response HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard
Dashboard element user-role contains text viewer

cases.title: Sign‑in with unknown email returns generic error
expected_results: Response HTTP 401
Element login-error contains text "Invalid email or password."

cases.title: User receives reset link and can set a new password
steps: GET /_test/outbox?to=viewer@testmu.local and extract reset link token
Enter new password newStrongPass1 into reset-password
expected_results: Response HTTP 303 redirect to /login?reason=reset
Element login-notice contains text "Your password has been updated. Please sign in."
Subsequent sign‑in with new password succeeds (HTTP 303 to /dashboard)

cases.title: Reset link expires exactly after 30 minutes
expected_results: Response HTTP 400
Element reset-error contains text "This reset link is invalid or has expired."
No password reset form is displayed

cases.title: Forgot‑password does not reveal whether email exists
expected_results: Element forgot-confirmation contains text "If an account exists for that email, we've sent a password reset link."
GET /_test/outbox?to=nonexistent@testmu.local returns empty list

cases.title: Active session allows access to dashboard
steps: Enter email admin@testmu.local and password {{admin_password}} and submit
Within less than 1800 seconds, navigate to GET /dashboard with session cookie
expected_results: Response HTTP 200 (dashboard page)
Element user-role contains text admin

cases.title: Session expires exactly after 1800 seconds
steps: Sign in as viewer@testmu.local to obtain session cookie
Navigate to GET /dashboard with session cookie
expected_results: Response HTTP 303 redirect to /login?reason=expired
Element login-notice contains text "Your session has expired. Please sign in again."

cases.title: Accessing dashboard without a session redirects to login
steps: Navigate to GET /dashboard without any session cookie
expected_results: Response HTTP 303 redirect to /login
Login page shows no login-notice element

cases.title: Fifth consecutive failed login locks the account
steps: Repeat 5 times: navigate to GET /login, enter email admin@testmu.local, enter password badpass, click login-submit
expected_results: On the fifth attempt response HTTP 423
Element login-error contains text "Your account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again later."

cases.title: Correct password is rejected while account is locked
steps: Perform 5 consecutive failed attempts with wrong password for viewer@testmu.local to trigger lock
Immediately attempt login with correct password {{viewer_password}}
expected_results: Response HTTP 423
Element login-error contains text "Your account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again later."

cases.title: Account unlocks exactly after 15 minutes lockout period
steps: Perform 5 failed attempts to lock admin account
expected_results: Response HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard
Dashboard element user-role contains text admin

cases.title: Successful login after lockout period clears failure count
steps: Perform 5 failed attempts to lock viewer account
Immediately attempt another login with wrong password bad
expected_results: First post‑lock attempt response HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard
Second immediate wrong password attempt response HTTP 401
